(RIV-TA urn:riv:clinicalprocess:healthcond:certificate:SendMessageToRecipient:2).

errorId Tillåtna värden: VALIDATION_ERROR, APPLICATION_ERROR, TECHNICAL_ERROR, REVOKED.
